title: Specify cloth–cloth system modes
scope: Define self-contact, friction and distinct sheets; retain unsupported capability states until implementation.
acceptance: Separate self and inter-system behavior with measurable physical criteria.
Split missing operators and their public-API qualification into new leaf tasks.
evidence: PASS: docs/INTERACTION-MODES.md distinguishes intrinsic self contact from graph-owned cloth-cloth contact and defines swept vertex-triangle/edge-edge behavior, topology exclusions, separation and conservation tolerances.
PASS: P1-19 through P1-24 separate typed API controls, bounded contact generation, self solve, inter-system solve, portable scheduling and per-driver qualification.
PASS: python3 tools/reference/build.py --check-generated; public headers and generated specification remain consistent.
PASS: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/roadmap -p 'test_*.py'; 19 roadmap/lease tests passed.
PASS: ctest --test-dir build-foundations -R '(generated-api-check|interaction-capability|graph-validation)' --output-on-failure; 3/3 passed and cloth self/inter capabilities remain unadvertised.
REVIEW: API 0.2 has no cloth-cloth edge or cloth self-contact control; both exact capability scopes remain unsupported until P1-19 through P1-24 close.
